name: @smart-wizard/ui
description: Core styles for SmartWizard - framework-agnostic wizard component

scripts.build:core: sass src/core.scss dist/smartwizard.css && postcss dist/smartwizard.css -u autoprefixer cssnano -o dist/smartwizard.min.css --no-map
scripts.build:full: sass src/full.scss dist/smartwizard-full.css && postcss dist/smartwizard-full.css -u autoprefixer cssnano -o dist/smartwizard-full.min.css --no-map
scripts.build:themes: sass --load-path=src src/themes:dist/themes && postcss "dist/themes/*.css" !"dist/themes/*.min.css" -u autoprefixer cssnano --dir dist/themes --ext .min.css --no-map
scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:full && pnpm run build:themes
